title: Supported Content Types by Version
---

<!-- DO NOT EDIT: generated by scripts/sync_kb.py -->

Each reference page below lists every content type that a branch or released package can emit in `output.label`, together with its metadata (`mime_type`, `group`, `description`, `extensions`, `is_text`) and orthogonal stage-coverage flags (`in_heuristics`, `in_resolvers`, `in_ml_model`, `vetoed_by_resolvers`). Release snapshots are frozen when the release is cut; see [Models & Supported Content Types](/magika/core-concepts/models-and-content-types) for background.

| Version / Artifact | Pipeline Stages | Default Model | Supported Content Types |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `main` (unreleased development branch) | Heuristics + Format Resolvers + ML Model | [`standard_v3_3`](/magika/models/standard_v3_3) | [402 content types](/magika/content-types/main) |
| `magika` CLI `1.1.0` | Heuristics + ML Model | [`standard_v3_3`](/magika/models/standard_v3_3) | [216 content types](/magika/content-types/cli-v1_1_0) |
| Rust `magika` library `1.1.0` | Heuristics + ML Model | [`standard_v3_3`](/magika/models/standard_v3_3) | [216 content types](/magika/content-types/rust-v1_1_0) |
| Python `magika` `1.0.3` | Heuristics + ML Model | [`standard_v3_3`](/magika/models/standard_v3_3) | [216 content types](/magika/content-types/python-v1_0_3) |
| JavaScript / TypeScript `magika` `1.0.0` | Byte Heuristics + ML Model (TF.js) | [`standard_v3_3`](/magika/models/standard_v3_3) | [214 content types](/magika/content-types/js-v1_0_0) |
